title: UMAP-SMOTENC
summary: A research implementation of the UMAP-SMOTENC framework, a privacy-aware synthetic data generation method for tabular data with mixed feature types, published in Knowledge-Based Systems. Its experiment notebooks and pipeline compare the method against SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer, using SingleTableMetadata and conditional sampling as baseline synthesizers.
evidence: demo.ipynb:212 'synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata)\nsynthesizer.fit(train)' used alongside Condition sampling as comparison baseline
